name: miles-running
description: MILES, packaged as an Android and iOS app with Capacitor. The web app itself still needs nothing.

scripts.android: node scripts/build-www.js && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: node scripts/build-www.js && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android:release: node scripts/build-www.js && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
